Discover more Discover all destinations English English 简体中文 Close Arrow left Back Global menu Brand home English English 简体中文 Hangzhou, China Amanfayun Hidden away in a picturesque valley, Amanfayun is surrounded by tea fields, natural woodland and a pilgrimage circuit of seven ancient Buddhist temples. Just six kilometres from tranquil West Lake, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the resort is a place apart where stone pathways lead to shaded courtyards and 46 peaceful abodes, some over a century old. Accommodation Rooms & Suites Beneath picturesque clay tile roofs, each Room and Suite has its own unique layout with courtyard or forest views Accommodation Villas Spread over two storeys, the spacious, free-standing Villas offer separate living areas and private massage rooms View all acommodation Book now Dining Picturesque Fayun Pathway Meander through the green glades of Amanfayun and discover a variety of unique dining experiences along the Fayun Pathway. Wellness Inspired by Traditional Chinese Medicine Reflecting Chinese health and wellbeing traditions, the expansive Spa is set in serene gardens screened by bamboo groves, tea bushes and magnolia trees. Events Host the Perfect Event With tranquil natural surroundings, flexible event spaces and a range of activities, Amanfayun is ideal for private celebrations and business functions. Offers Discover China Discover China's heritage with a minimum six-night stay at two or more of Aman's Chinese properties. As well as daily breakfast and airport transfers, enjoy a range of experiences at each resort. Offers Extend Your Stay A three-night offer including a complimentary night, daily cultural experiences at Fayun Place, daily breakfast for two and treats from the mini bar, refreshed daily.
